source_discrepancies: v1 Conclusion says a gap remains for all kappa <= d^(2-delta), while Theorem 3.1 and Introduction claim matching in this regime. Keep this as a source discrepancy; do not silently repair the theorem or repeat the conclusion as an accepted open problem.
Lemma A.1 contains both n>=2 and a trailing n>=3 phrase. The determinant application uses n=2T+1>=3; any generalized spherical lemma needs its own dimension audit.

The Introduction also claims to confirm the conjecture whenever sqrt(kappa) log d <= d. The explicit Theorem 3.1 bound alone does not cover this entire region: with kappa=d^2/(log d)^2 and fixed epsilon, it gives order d log(log d)/log d, whereas the conjectured expression is order d. Retain this as a source-claim-versus-theorem-coverage discrepancy, not a refutation or silent repair of Theorem 3.1.
